companyDescription: Autonomous Delivery Robots · NVIDIA-powered last-mile robot fleet backed by Uber
priceNote: At 52-week low ($6.02–$18.64) — was $18.64 high. Revenue +578% YoY Q1. Dilution shelf $300M filed — key risk.
summary: SERV is a ค่าขนม-grade autonomous delivery robot play backed by NVIDIA and Uber. Q1 2026 revenue +578% YoY, 2026 guidance $26M, expanding beyond food into laundry (NoScrubs). Moon case: scale to 10K+ robot fleet. Bear case: dilution ($300M shelf) crushes equity before profitability.

catalysts.name: Q2 Earnings & Fleet Milestone
catalysts.description: Fleet scaling update toward 2,000+ robots. Uber Eats contract execution and new verticals (White Castle, NoScrubs laundry). Revenue acceleration from $3M Q1 toward $26M FY guidance.

catalysts.name: NVIDIA Partnership Depth
catalysts.description: Maggie AI conversational robot debuted at NVIDIA GTC 2026 — edge AI integration signals NVIDIA platform validation. Any hardware order or expanded partnership = major catalyst.

catalysts.name: Fleet 10K Expansion Announcement
catalysts.description: Management has guided 2,000 robots by year-end. Moon case: Uber contract scales to 10K+ robots, creating first true commercial robot-as-a-service recurring revenue model in the US.

risks: $300M mixed securities shelf filed May 2026 — dilution risk is #1 bear case; equity could be cut 40–60%
Revenue is still tiny ($26M FY2026 guidance vs $473M market cap = 18x P/S) — any miss crushes stock
Cathie Wood / institutional sentiment has been volatile; high short interest; Freedom Broker downgraded to Hold
Uber could build in-house robots or switch vendors — single customer concentration risk
Physical robot business has path-to-profit uncertainty — losses were -$137M TTM on $5M revenue

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Rate-neutral — robot-as-a-service revenue model not rate-sensitive
macroRisk.inflationNote: Inflation actually benefits SERV: human labor cost inflation drives robotics adoption faster
macroRisk.sectorImpact: AI robotics sector decoupled from rate cycle — catalyst-driven pure play
macroRisk.summary: Fed risk LOW. SERV's growth tied to robot fleet utilization + Uber contract execution, not rate environment. Main macro risk is consumer spending slowdown cutting Uber Eats order volume.
